issues.on_page: Capital outlay (Special Building Fund column 20,940,888 = Purchased services 349,138 + Buildings and sites 20,591,750)
issues.issue: Special Building Fund 'Purchased services' 349,138 (p18) is printed under Capital outlay on the governmental funds statement (p5); the function was guessed as support services, so the detail function split does not tie to the statement. Should be capital outlay (detail_category professional/contract services can stay).

issues.on_page: Cooperative receipts 1,503,416 (Cooperative Fund 'Tuition and other receipts', p20; shown as Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities, p1)
issues.issue: The report itself classifies this as charges for services (tuition from cooperating districts); extractor rules treat service-contract/interlocal revenue as charges for services/fees. Defensible either way; already marked review.
Label says tuition; 'tuition and fees' (category charges for services/fees) fits the label and the Statement of Activities' Charges for Services column (p1). Judgment call.

issues.on_page: County sources 90,979 (budget schedule p9: 2110 County fines and license fees)
issues.issue: Line is county-distributed fines and license fees; intergovernmental is defensible (paid by the county), but 'fines and forfeitures' could also fit. Same applies to detail[9].
Same label 'Activities receipts' in the Activities Fund (detail[96]) is 'student activity receipts'; student fees could also be 'tuition and fees'. Inconsistent detail category for the same label.

issues.on_page: Reclassifications column: Instruction 2,130,930, Private and state categorical programs (687,820), Federal programs (1,943,110), Total disbursements (500,000); p8 Transfers reclassification (500,000) vs Depreciation Fund 500,000
issues.issue: Contra line and matching other financing line detail[90] (-500,000) are derived by the extractor from the reclassification columns, not printed as lines; arithmetic holds (lines 46,243,388 - 500,000 + 2,130,930 reclass = Instruction etc.; Depreciation Fund transfer in 500,000 p14 matches) and both are marked split_from/review. Assumption that the 500,000 sits inside the program lines is reasonable but should be confirmed.
